description: This is a unit test class for ImmutableMessageHeaders in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies immutability, equality, construction, and retrieval of message header properties, utilizing various known headers, external libraries (AssertJ, EqualsVerifier), and dependencies related to message headers and JSON handling.

classes.name: ImmutableMessageHeadersTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the ImmutableMessageHeaders class, testing its immutability, equality, header construction, value retrieval, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableMessageHeaders instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for ImmutableMessageHeaders.

methods.name: settingAllKnownHeadersWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Constructs a MessageHeaders object with all known headers and verifies correctness.

methods.name: createInstanceOfValidHeaderMapWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies creation of MessageHeaders from a Map of headers.

methods.name: createInstanceOfValidHeaderJsonObjectWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies creation of MessageHeaders from a JSON object representing headers.

methods.name: putKeyValuePairWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests adding a custom key-value pair to headers.

methods.name: tryToPutKnownHeaderWithInvalidValue
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when an invalid value is used for a known header.

methods.name: getDirectionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of message direction.

methods.name: getSubjectReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of message subject.

methods.name: getThingIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of the Thing ID as a string.

methods.name: getFeatureIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that feature ID is correctly retrieved.

methods.name: getTimeoutReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the timeout value.

methods.name: getTimestampReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of timestamp as OffsetDateTime.

methods.name: getStatusCodeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of HTTP status code.

methods.name: getDirectionAlthoughItIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures proper exception when direction header is missing.

methods.name: getSubjectAlthoughItIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures proper exception when subject header is missing.

methods.name: getThingIdAlthoughItIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures proper exception when Thing ID header is missing.
